accepted.evidence: Trail and Cooper explicitly give ṣuṭík ashes, Urtsun śuṛík, with etymology *kṣuttikā powder, T-3709.2. The source page was checked directly: printed page 294 (PDF page 319), not the imported record’s printed-page estimate 289. Turner’s second branch gives Ashkun śutī ashes and Khowar chuti soil/dust; the exact powder subsection is used.
